chunks: Our duty is to convey the message clearly.

key_terms.بَلَاغٌ: Conveyance or delivery of a message

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Balagh Al-Mubin' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the infallible Imams' role as perfect conveyors of the divine message, mirroring the Prophet's duty, while absolving them of forcing belief upon the people. It establishes a theological boundary where human responsibility is limited to clear proclamation (balagh), whereas true guidance (hidayah) remains exclusively with God, reinforcing the concept of divine decree alongside human free will.
